newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar closes barely higher, in range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar closes barely higher, in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled barely firmer, having set its ten-point range early and then drifting for the remainder of the session.
Speculative buying and trade scale-up selling was cited in the March contract. Activity in the March/May spread was also noted, traders said.
They set nearby resistance in March at 10.47 cents and then at 10.52 cents, where commission house and fund buying is likely to emerge.
March closed up 0.02 to 10.44 cents, having traded from 10.46 to 10.36 cents. The back months finished 0.03 lower to 0.01 higher.
